# windowsddi_dhcp_scope (Data Source)

Looks up one IPv4 scope by ID (`Get-DhcpServerv4Scope`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "windowsddi_dhcp_scope" "users" {
  scope_id = "10.1.20.0"
}

output "users_range" {
  value = "${data.windowsddi_dhcp_scope.users.start_range}-${data.windowsddi_dhcp_scope.users.end_range}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_id` (String) Scope ID (network address) to look up, for example `10.1.2.0`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Scope description.
- `end_range` (String) Last address of the range.
- `lease_duration` (String) Lease duration as `d.hh:mm:ss`.
- `name` (String) Scope name.
- `start_range` (String) First address of the range.
- `state` (String) Scope state as reported by the server (`Active` or `Inactive`).
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask.
- `type` (String) Clients served: `Dhcp`, `Bootp` or `Both`.
